verdict.rationale: Luma documents character references for its video model and says Luma Agents carry style references, character references, and visual grounding into every asset. That points toward cross-asset consistency, but it is marketing-level and centered on reference inputs rather than demonstrated character or scene persistence across multiple shots. Multi-Keyframe works only inside a single clip, so it does not count here. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of how a character or scene is held across separate shots, any limits on that consistency, and independent hands-on corroboration of multi-shot consistency.

support.subject: As a creator, a character or scene stays consistent across multiple generated shots, not just within one clip
